purpose: Teach: 見え隠れ/王位/財投/先立ち/国務省/血縁/検疫/受難

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、警察、容疑者の見え隠れする動きを警戒されてますね
lines.en: I notice the police are being cautious about the suspect's movements—they seem to be watching carefully for any sign of him.
lines.style: Measured, analytical tone. Pause slightly before the observation. Genuine curiosity underneath the formal phrasing. Lean into the question respectfully.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、王位継承の混乱に乗じた犯罪を警戒します
lines.en: The police are on alert for criminal activity that could exploit the confusion surrounding the succession.
lines.style: Official but not cold. Steady, even delivery. Each clause gets the same weight. No embellishment—just the facts, stated with quiet authority.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、財投を悪用した詐欺を警察、捜査されてますね
lines.en: From what I understand, the police are investigating fraud involving misuse of investment funds in this case.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause after the opening. Careful articulation of the accusation—not assuming, but noting what the investigation has revealed. Slight lift at the end.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、本件は事件発生に先立ち兆候がありました
lines.en: There were warning signs before the incident occurred, which we've been tracking from the outset.
lines.style: Deliberate, factual. Slight emphasis on 'before'—the hindsight is part of the point. Professional composure. No apology in the tone.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、米国国務省との情報共有を警察、進められてますね
lines.en: I understand information is being shared with the U.S. State Department—the police are coordinating internationally on this.
lines.style: Appreciative of the observation. Nod in the voice. International coordination stated as matter-of-fact. Respects the question's implication.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、血縁関係の確認も丁寧に行います
lines.en: We're also being thorough about confirming family relationships—it requires care and attention to detail.
lines.style: Quiet emphasis on 'thorough.' Professional but slightly warmer. Acknowledges the sensitivity without dwelling. Steady and unhurried.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、国際検疫を擦り抜けた事案を警察、ご対応中ですね
lines.en: We're currently handling the case of individuals who managed to evade international quarantine procedures.
lines.style: Factual, slightly more alert than before. The phrase lands with quiet weight. No frustration, but the seriousness is clear. Direct eye contact in the voice.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、受難の歴史を持つ被害者ご家族に寄り添います
lines.en: What we're committed to is standing with the victim's family—they carry a difficult history, and they deserve our care.
lines.style: Softer than before, but still formal. Genuine warmth without overstepping professional boundaries. Slow, deliberate pace. The commitment is clear in the weight of each word.
